summary: We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our world-class software development team. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will seek resolutions to problems and mitigate risks, always ensuring a Customer Obsessed experience.
responsibilities: You Will Work With Other Amazon Leaders To Share Ideas And Improve Support Across The Company. You Will Demonstrate Excellent Judgment When Making Decisions.
required_skills: 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
Experience scripting in modern program languages
Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON
benefits: Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
